concepts.name: 24 HEALTH AND PHYSICAL EDUCATION STUDENT
concepts.simple_definition: 24 HEALTH AND PHYSICAL EDUCATION STUDENT’S TEXT BOOK From the various types of training methods, circuit training is a good example to perform different types of exercise at one time
concepts.deep_explanation: Circuit training is a series of exercises, completed for a certain amount of time, one after the other, developing aerobic and anaerobic respiration
